##### Project general facts

The Autograph S Series by Green Group is a residential project offering a collection of thoughtfully designed apartments with spacious layouts and premium finishes. The development reflects the developer's vision of sustainable, comfortable living and is well suited to modern urban residents looking for a quality home.

Residents have access to a range of amenities, including a fully equipped fitness centre, a swimming pool and landscaped gardens. These facilities create a comfortable environment for relaxation and an active lifestyle within the building.

The apartments feature stone-finish tiles and anti-bacterial granite surfaces in a matte black finish. The building is equipped with a centralised ventilation and ecology system with odour and pollutant control, as well as anti-odour and pest-resistant solutions. Kitchens come with a built-in fridge, gas hob, hood and built-in microwave, while a built-in oven and dishwasher are included in all units except the Designer Suites. Lighting is provided by energy-efficient LED fixtures, and the apartments are delivered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

The project is located in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), a fast-growing residential community in Dubai. The neighbourhood is known for its distinctive circular layout, which combines modern residential buildings with green open spaces.

JVC features tree-lined streets, quiet parks and a mix of villas and apartments, creating a calm and welcoming atmosphere. The community offers a peaceful setting away from the busier parts of the city while remaining conveniently connected to the rest of Dubai.

Residents of JVC have access to schools, shopping centres, parks and recreational facilities within the community. This makes the area attractive for families, working professionals and investors alike.
